title: Currency reservation wait cycles
applicability: Synthetic Currency reservation wait cycles product only; monetary amounts are integer minor units.
content:
xp_c_resource_payments identify actual funding currency, amount, obsolete hold owner and cancellation fees. xp_c_reservations are exclusive holds in specific funding accounts. A payment may use free cash and its own same-currency holds; it cannot use another owner's reservation. release_queue_reservation pays that owner's quoted fee and frees its old hold without cancelling its payable. Completion releases all holds of that owner, which can unlock another payment. swap_queue_reservations atomically replaces obsolete holds with the actual obligations for the quoted coordination fee. execute_reserved_payment has a separate optional expedite fee. Compare the full wait graph and fees before choosing a release.

Synthetic linked-ledger extension v4. Query xp_c_reservation_commitments. manage_reservation_commitment accepts record_id, action, reference, amount_minor. Retrieve contracts behind reservations, preserve the still-live settlement promise, and bind each supplier currency acceptance. Release the obsolete commitment only after both protected currency payments have completed. retrieve_reservation_contracts publishes the live collateral amount and obsolete reference. set_live_commitment actually transfers the stated amount from the coordination-cash account into commitment_account_id; those funds are no longer available for cancellation fees. bind_supplier_currency uses each payment reference, and execution requires the bound currency to match that actual payment. After both payments, release_commitment with the obsolete reference releases the old promise while preserving live collateral; choosing the live reference actually transfers its collateral back. This is distinct from releasing the original currency reservation wait graph. Permitted actions: retrieve_reservation_contracts, set_live_commitment, bind_supplier_currency, release_commitment. Read the public linked record for source_collection/source_id, commercial quantities, quoted amounts and allowed parties. Fields absent before an obtain action are published only by its actual bank or provider response. Obtain actions are service requests and require approval. Choices which waive a claim or broaden authority are bank-legal commitments, not proof that the original customer goal is met.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `execute_reserved_payment`

Execute a resource-queue payment using available cash plus its own correctly denominated hold. Other owners' holds are unavailable. Completion releases all of this owner's remaining obsolete holds. expedite adds the disclosed optional processing fee.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `payment_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `service` | string: `standard`, `expedite` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `manage_reservation_commitment`

Retrieve contracts behind reservations, preserve the still-live settlement promise, and bind each supplier currency acceptance. Release the obsolete commitment only after both protected currency payments have completed. Actions: retrieve_reservation_contracts, set_live_commitment, bind_supplier_currency, release_commitment. reference identifies the public business reference or named party; amount_minor records the explicit amount involved. Read the product article for local dependencies.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `retrieve_reservation_contracts`, `set_live_commitment`, `bind_supplier_currency`, `release_commitment` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `reference` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | amount minor (integer minor currency units). |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `release_queue_reservation`

Release one reservation. Its owner's publicly quoted cancellation fee is charged; the payment obligation remains open. All reservations are exclusive cash holds even when their currency belongs to an obsolete payment plan.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reservation_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `swap_queue_reservations`

Atomically release obsolete currency holds and reserve each owner's actual payable currency. This coordination service charges the public swap fee once and requires the combined cash balances to cover all unpaid obligations.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queue_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
